acceptance_criteria.criterion: Navigating to #/projects/:id fetches the project via GET /api/projects/:id and displays the project's metadata (ID, name, description), repositories list, and workspaces list.
Adding a repository presents a selection from the global repository list (filtered to exclude already-added repos) and calls POST /api/projects/:id/repositories with { repositoryId }.
Removing a repository from the project shows a confirmation dialog and calls DELETE /api/projects/:id/repositories/:repoId on confirm.
The 'Add Workspace' form validates the workspace ID format (2-6 uppercase A-Z letters) and creates the workspace via POST /api/projects/:id/workspaces with { workspaceId, description }.
The STABLE workspace's delete button is visually disabled and non-functional.
Renaming a project shows a confirmation dialog explaining filesystem consequences, calls PUT /api/projects/:id/rename with { newId }, and navigates to #/projects/:newId on success.
